visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair wearing a grey long-sleeved top and black pants waves at the camera in a brightly lit indoor studio setting. (2) She holds two retail boxes for the Insta360 Ace Pro 2 and an Xplorer Grip Kit while animated variety text overlays appear above her head. (3) Hands carefully unbox the action camera and its accessories, including a battery and wind covers, against the white product packaging. (4) The components of the grip kit, such as the cage and magnetic handle, are laid out and pointed to one by one. (5) The woman demonstrates how to attach the protective cage to the camera body, with text graphics indicating the weight of the device in various configurations. (6) Close-up shots detail the opening of the side ports for USB and memory cards and the use of a coin-like tool to tighten the magnetic handle. (7) The woman wears sunglasses and films herself outdoors against a white wall, followed by scenes of her using the camera inside a boutique store. (8) The camera's touchscreen is shown displaying technical specs and various filter modes while she takes a selfie with another woman. (9) A smartphone interface is shown demonstrating the associated editing app and tutorial videos. (10) The woman appears in lifestyle snippets, smiling while outdoors in a white dress and later drinking coffee in a cafe setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, mid-tempo electronic music track. A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks the appearance of visual titles. (2) A rustling sound occurs as the narrator presents the product boxes, followed by a series of soft thuds and plastic crinkles as the camera and its components are removed from their packaging. (3) A metallic click and a short mechanical friction sound are audible when the camera cage is attached. The BGM maintains a consistent beat strength and energy level. (4) A distinct 'press' click sound effect highlights the operation of a physical button on the camera body. The voice remains clear and informative throughout the technical description. (5) A percussive clinking sound accompanies the installation of the magnetic handle with a coin tool. The acoustic environment is a clean studio recording. (6) A snapping sound indicates the insertion of a cold shoe accessory. The background music continues with a steady electronic synth texture. (7) A subtle transition 'whoosh' leads into a lifestyle segment where faint outdoor ambient noise and urban traffic hum become briefly noticeable behind the narration. (8) Multiple camera shutter sound effects and UI 'pops' occur as photography modes and mobile app features are demonstrated. (9) The video concludes with the speaker saying 'bye-bye' in a high-pitched, friendly tone as the music fades out quickly.
